   1 class_name InteractionSystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 var _last_tick: int = -1
   5 
   6 func setup() -> void:
   7 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
   8 
   9 func query() -> QueryBuilder:
  10 	return q.with_all([C_Interaction, C_Transform]).enabled()
  11 
  12 func process(_entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, _delta: float) -> void:
  13 	if _last_tick == runtime.tick_index:
  14 		return
  15 	_last_tick = runtime.tick_index
  16 	var interactions: Array = runtime.world.query.with_all([C_Interaction, C_Transform, C_RoomMember]).enabled().execute()
  17 	var nearest: Entity = null
  18 	var best_distance: float = INF
  19 	var player: Entity = runtime.player
  20 	var feet: Vector2 = player.get_component(C_Transform).position
  21 	var motion: C_Motion = player.get_component(C_Motion)
  22 	for entity in interactions:
  23 		if not entity.enabled:
  24 			continue
  25 		var interaction: C_Interaction = entity.get_component(C_Interaction)
  26 		interaction.selected = false
  27 		interaction.requested = false
  28 		if not interaction.available or runtime.session.mode != "playing" or not motion.grounded or motion.placement_pending:
  29 			continue
  30 		if entity.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id != runtime.session.room_id:
  31 			continue
  32 		var position: Vector2 = entity.get_component(C_Transform).position
  33 		var distance: float = feet.distance_to(position)
  34 		# Feet-level and grounded checks prevent reaching a high door from a jump below it.
  35 		if absf(feet.y - position.y) > 35.0 or distance > interaction.radius or distance >= best_distance:
  36 			continue
  37 		var ray := PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.create(feet + Vector2(0, -48), position + Vector2(0, -48), 1)
  38 		if not runtime.get_world_2d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(ray).is_empty():
  39 			continue
  40 		nearest = entity
  41 		best_distance = distance
  42 	if nearest != null:
  43 		var chosen: C_Interaction = nearest.get_component(C_Interaction)
  44 		chosen.selected = true
  45 		chosen.requested = player.get_component(C_Input).interact_pressed
  46 	for entity in interactions:
  47 		if not entity.enabled:
  48 			continue
  49 		var body: C_Body = entity.get_component(C_Body)
  50 		if body != null and is_instance_valid(body.root):
  51 			var prompt: Label = body.root.get_node_or_null("InteractionPrompt")
  52 			if prompt != null:
  53 				prompt.visible = entity.get_component(C_Interaction).selected
  54 				if prompt.visible:
  55 					var canvas: Transform2D = body.root.get_global_transform_with_canvas()
  56 					var viewport_size: Vector2 = runtime.get_viewport_rect().size
  57 					var desired: Vector2 = canvas * Vector2(-280, -150)
  58 					var scaled_size: Vector2 = prompt.size * canvas.get_scale().abs()
  59 					desired.x = clampf(desired.x, 20.0, maxf(20.0, viewport_size.x - scaled_size.x - 20.0))
  60 					desired.y = clampf(desired.y, 160.0, maxf(160.0, viewport_size.y - scaled_size.y - 80.0))
  61 					prompt.position = canvas.affine_inverse() * desired
